remarks: Welcome to the highly sought-after Rowayton Woods community, where you can enjoy picturesque grounds including a pool, tennis court, pond view, and a community garden. This beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit features vaulted ceilings, an updated kitchen, and a cozy fireplace. You'll appreciate the convenience of being walking distance to the dog park, train station, restaurants, and the charming downtown Rowayton. The unit also boasts a new washer and dryer, a brand-new HVAC system installed this year, and a hot water heater that's less than 5 years old. Don't miss the opportunity to make this inviting home in Rowayton Woods your own and enjoy all the comfort and convenience.
